about: Street food layer (Gent first): places with a sourced street-food format (bao/taco/dumpling/falafel/ramen counter, fixed foodtruck, artisanal snack). Applied in js/common.js load() as features.streetFood. Not a cuisine — keeps real cuisineTags. Built 5 Nov 2026 (preview-gent-streetfood).
